subject: Mutual action plan + milestone-linked private offer for Acme Retail
messages:
From: Alice Kelly <alice.kelly@acmeretail.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 13:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: initial sync - mutual action plan

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo last week. The team liked the latency numbers but we need a concrete MAP that ties evaluation milestones to a private offer across AWS/Azure/GCP — procurement will not sign without clear commit/ramp triggers.

High level asks from our side:
- A 6-week evaluation plan (S1: perf smoke, S2: feature tests, S3: pilot with 50k tokens/day)
- Milestone-linked discounts: small pilot pricing, then stepped discounts at 3x and 5x committed usage
- Private offers in at least one marketplace (we prefer AWS first) and fallback plans for Azure/GCP
- Outline of legal/Procurement steps and expected lead times

Can you send a draft MAP + sample private-offer term sheet we can circulate? Procurement is cc'd (procurement@acmeretail.com).

Best,
Alice
Alice Kelly
Director, AI Product
Acme Retail
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Kelly <alice.kelly@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, procurement@acmeretail.com
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + milestone-linked private offer for Acme Retail

Alice / Procurement team — attached is a first-pass MAP and a zipped draft of the private-offer artifacts (pricing ladder + sample 90/365 SLA clauses). Attachment names: Acme_MAP_v1.pdf, Redwood_PrivateOffer_Draft.zip.

High-level summary of what we propose:
1) Evaluation sprint (weeks 0-6)
   - Week 0-1: Integration + perf smoke (test models, 2k seq length)
   - Week 2-3: Feature pass (tooling, streaming, function-calls)
   - Week 4-6: Pilot (50k tokens/day, 24/7 load windows, vanity staging)

2) MAP-linked commercial steps (applies when pilot metrics meet SLOs)
   - Pilot: transient pilot credits (30% off hosted list) while we validate output quality
   - Ramp trigger 1 (3x baseline): automated discount unlocks 12% off quoted unit price + 30-day committed capacity reserve in AWS private offer
   - Ramp trigger 2 (5x baseline): additional 10% discount (stacked) and access to burst capacity / dedicated pool scheduling

3) Marketplace private-offer plan
   - Primary: AWS Private Offer (we can submit a staged private offer that evolves with the MAP milestones)
   - Secondary: Azure/GCP templates included in the ZIP for partner/legal review

4) Timeline & next steps
   - If we sign the MAP this week, engineering will provision pilot infra within 10 business days.
   - We will target an AWS private-offer submission after pilot success (expected week 7) with typical vendor review windows of 7-14 business days.

Notes: Pricing steps are conditional on meeting the success criteria in the MAP (latency < 120ms p95 on test harness, quality A/B delta within 5% of baseline). Legal redlines that materially change vendor risk/profile will push timelines.

Questions for procurement: any formal compliance evidence (SOC 2 or data residency) we should bundle with the private-offer? We can include SOC 2 type II summary and audit contact.

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Alice Kelly <alice.kelly@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, procurement@acmeretail.com
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + milestone-linked private offer for Acme Retail

Adding details on the commercial mechanics so procurement can vet: 

- Commit cadence: we recommend a 12-month staged commit that starts with a 3-month minimum pilot tranche (no long-term commitments during pilot). After pilot success, commits auto-convert to a 9-month ramp with monthly reporting and rollback windows.
- Discounting: staged discounts are applied to the committed consumption band only. Example: commit = 100k tokens/month baseline. At 3x actual consumption we apply the 12% discount to the new consumption band and retro credits for the pilot month.
- Private-offer technicals: for AWS Private Offer we will provide a PO template tying the discount tiers to a MarketPlace private-offer code. For Azure/GCP we provide equivalent SDR templates but procurement will need to accept cloud vendor terms (MS CSP or GCP reseller flows).
- Billing & invoices: Redwood issues monthly invoices against private-offer usage records; procurement can require net-30 or net-45 depending on credit checks.

Attachment note: the ZIP includes a sample Marketplace private-offer JSON payload and a checklist for vendor onboarding.

Next step proposed by sales: 1) procurement to confirm any mandatory contract clauses, 2) accept MAP v1 as the evaluation plan, 3) schedule a legal touchpoint to walk the private-offer templates (we can host a 30-min session early next week).

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Alice Kelly <alice.kelly@acmeretail.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmeretail.com, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + milestone-linked private offer for Acme Retail

Thanks Olga and Marcus — this is very helpful. Procurement confirmed SOC 2 summary and our legal team will review the private-offer templates (they asked for the AWS PO JSON you referenced).

We are good to proceed on the MAP v1. Action items on our side:
- Legal (Acme) to review private-offer attachments and flag any non-starters (target: Tue 27 Apr)
- Procurement to confirm preferred billing term (net-30 vs net-45) by Mon 26 Apr
- Product team to provide the pilot manifest (test cases and traffic profile) by Tue 20 Apr — I copied product but will send separately.

We will schedule an exec review on Thu 29 Apr to sign off on moving the pilot to AWS Private Offer submission. If all goes to plan we should hit the ramp trigger 1 within 8 weeks of pilot start.

Appreciate the clarity — please keep the AWS private-offer draft handy for the legal call.

Best,
Alice
Alice Kelly
Director, AI Product
Acme Retail
